implementation_decisions: Maintenance capability split from commit capability: PayloadMaintenanceStore (read/list_objects/stat_object/delete_object) — the commit path never gains delete authority; tmp-scratch ops stay a detected local-only optional capability
GC retry now delegates to the shared run_with_contention_retry (with on_retry observability feeding busy_retries) — one vocabulary, asyncpg DBAPIError shape already fixed in 6f95e4b

Linearization scope PAYLOAD_DECISION_LOCK_SCOPE chosen over per-blob locks: GC decisions, root/pin writers, activation, and payload commits all contend on one scope; collision-freedom is not required, only mutual serialization; commit acquires it before the head row to keep a single global lock order
ObjectStat.last_modified_epoch is store-clock metadata (mtime / S3 Last-Modified), used only for orphan age grace — never causal truth
Lexical retirement on PostgreSQL fails closed pre-write rather than being profile-gated silently: a dormant FTS artifact is inspectable evidence, a half-retired one is corruption
Barrier pause hooks are test-only parameters on execute_collection, mirroring the established _inject_fault_at pattern
known_deviations_and_nonclaims: industrial lexical index / PublicationSet query serving on PostgreSQL remains unimplemented — FTS5 generations are SQLite-only and their retirement fails closed on PG (X-C14); this session does not claim query-serving parity
source-artifact topology (LocalSourceStore) remains local filesystem — no stateless-replica claim
no HA failover, no cross-region object store, no backup/restore drills, no RPO/RTO claims (PR83C)
S3 profile is single-PUT, unversioned buckets, path-style, ETag not trusted — one implementation (MinIO-tested) does not certify every S3-compatible vendor
PR69 dynamic model admission and PR84 readiness/compatibility remain out of scope
pr83_followups: industrial PublicationSet/query-serving slice (real lexical index, atomic membership, mixed-generation query proofs)
industrial source-artifact topology if stateless replicas are required
